others.route: Work permit (Department General for Employment of Foreign Nationals)

note: Iran: a foreigner needs the work permit, or employment licence, of the Ministry of Cooperatives, Labour and Social Welfare's Department General for Employment of Foreign Nationals for any employment (Labour Law arts. 120–129), requested by the employer and granted only where no Iranian has the same skills; one year, renewable. Read from a law firm's note (2016), since the ministry's and the missions' sites don't reach this client.

sources.title: Legalmondo, Iran: work permit for foreigners (17 June 2016)
sources.said: Expats require a work permit, or employment license, in Iran for any type of employment. The organ in charge is the “Department General for Employment of Foreign Nationals”, a division of the Ministry of Cooperative, Labor and Social Welfare. The requirements are set in articles 120-129 of Iran Labor Law.
